do not stop until you have delivered the entire application 
I want an app that looks at all the repos for acmeproducts that is a dashboard this is the main screen to see what the state of each repo is when it was last accesed, if it is set up for a gitpages - if it is not, there needs to be an option to analyze that repo and determine how to establish a functional launch page if it doesnt exist and to make the necessary config changes, there should be an assessment of what the repo does in some cases there is a one to one releaitnoship between app and repo, when a repo has many apps there needs to be a chevron that opens up that shows the status and a launch link for each app howwever multiple versions must be grouped under a chevron to allow launch of previous versions of the same application in the same repo. the left rail for repo and then a tabbed interface on the right side so there is a repo overview then a repo app tab and whatever is appropriate for that repo maybe its code with code links maybe its readme or install I will leave the details to you but this framework needs to be used so that the right side is custromized for that repo not a onesize fits all approach. Basically I want to get a handle on on my repos and have a central opeerations and control point
